provenance: Inspired by the joint position/rate HMM concept in tiktoktrendz/rogii-dip-aware-hmm-gbm, but independently reduced to a target-free forward filter. Public same-well/contact overrides, pretrained submission lookup, meta learner, leaderboard claims, and submission code are excluded.
hypothesis: A joint TVT-position and local dip-rate state can use trajectory geometry and hidden GR to correct structural branch errors not represented by whole-well residual regressors.

discovery_contract.well_selection: first 32 well IDs after SHA-256 sort

stop_rule: If discovery fails any gate, stop permanently without changing HMM states, grid, band, transition, overlay, or clip. Only a full discovery PASS authorizes untouched-well confirmation; no discovery result authorizes a submission directly.
